name: 22840 · Mcgaheysville, VA
findings: ZIP 22840 (Mcgaheysville) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22840 (Mcgaheysville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
